qualification.formal_scope: Reuses the existing slot/reflection/rooting/image-payload contracts qualified in task-owned-fields-20261019.json. No new lifecycle transition or abstract model was added; actual owner projection, aliases and resets are exercised here.

assessment: Three interleaved runs per variant: 20 prepare/close operations 187.289 to 191.127 ms (+2.0%); 500 explicitly requested field reads 195.124 to 207.052 ms (+6.1%). The preparation batch adds zero retained facts versus 80. These are small costs, not a speedup claim or a significant end-to-end regression. The initial explicit-view loop was +10.3%; removing the redundant mapper hop reduced that cost. No GC or scheduling policy changed.
